// diagnostic

E0040

`async` or `await` was written.

What

`async` or `await` was written.

Why

Jet uses blocking tasks and channels rather than async syntax.

Fix

use `core.tasks as tasks` and call `tasks.spawn(() -> work())`.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0040: tests/ui/async_await_teaching.stderr.

Error [E0040]: `async` is not in Jet; use the `task` keyword instead
  --> tests/ui/async_await_teaching.jet:2:5
    |
  2 |     async(42)
    |     ^^^^^
 Why: Jet uses blocking tasks and channels, not async/await — simpler and race-free
 Fix: write `task your_work()` or `task { … }`
